summary: Pyrophyte Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that its sponsor deposited $227,093.10 plus $3,782.71 interest into the trust account for monthly extensions through April 2026, and disclosed a definitive proxy statement for a fourth extension of its business-combination deadline. These are routine SPAC trust-funding and extension-meeting filings, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer. No deal terms are presented.
